backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing reminder and messaging system with access control, user profiles, and CRUD operations for reminders and messages with authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: authentication requirement, landing page, user-specific messaging, and profile setup dialog with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files describing components for authentication, reminders, messaging, voice features, and layout with warm color palette.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes using neutral warm palette with terracotta primary and sand secondary colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for VoiceMate app with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component that conditionally renders landing page for unauthenticated users, profile setup dialog for first-time users, or main app layout with reminders/messages views for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button component with loading states, query cache clearing on logout, and error handling for authentication state.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for first-time authenticated users to enter their display name and save profile to backend with form validation.
frontend/src/components/landing/LandingP: Landing page with hero section, app logo, feature grid showcasing reminders/messaging/voice/privacy capabilities, and prominent login button for unauthenticated visitors.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout component with header, navigation (Reminders/Messages tabs), user profile display, login button, and footer. Includes responsive mobile navigation and branding with logo.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Messag: Form component for composing and sending messages with recipient Principal ID input, message textarea, and voice input support via MicButton. Handles message submission with validation and toast notifications.

Displays a list of sent and received messages with sender/recipient info, timestamps, reminder attachments, and delete functionality. Includes UserDisplay sub-component to show user profiles or truncated Principal IDs.

Main messages view container that displays user's Principal ID with copy button, MessageComposer component, and MessagesList with loading state. Shows message count and instructions for sharing Principal ID.
frontend/src/components/reminders/DueNow: Alert panel that displays reminders due now with a destructive/warning style. Shows reminder details and provides a complete button for each due reminder, hidden when no reminders are due.
frontend/src/components/reminders/Remind: Dialog form for creating and editing reminders with title, notes, due date/time fields, and voice input support. Handles both create and update operations with validation and converts dates to nanosecond timestamps.

Displays a filterable list of reminders with options to mark complete, edit, delete, send, and speak each reminder. Includes loading states, empty states, and formatting for due dates with visual indicators for overdue and today's reminders.
Button component that uses text-to-speech to read reminder details aloud including title, notes, and due date. Shows speaking animation and handles browser TTS support detection.
Main reminders view component that combines a header with 'New Reminder' button, DueNowPanel for urgent reminders, RemindersList for all reminders, and ReminderEditor dialog.
frontend/src/components/reminders/SendRe: Dialog component for sending a reminder as a message to another user by entering their Principal ID, with form validation and error handling.
Button component that integrates speech-to-text functionality, showing visual feedback during recording and automatically passing transcribed text to a callback function.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor with authentication, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Hook that combines Internet Identity authentication state with user profile data, providing a unified interface for current user information including principal and authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useDueNowReminders.ts: Hook that filters reminders to find incomplete ones with due dates in the past or present, checking every 30 seconds for newly due reminders.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout, managing AuthClient lifecycle, identity persistence, and login status states throughout the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, reminders CRUD, messages, and reminder-to-message conversion, with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechToText.ts: Hook that wraps the Web Speech API for speech recognition, managing listening state, transcript results, browser compatibility detection, and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useTextToSpeech.ts: React hook that wraps the browser's SpeechSynthesis API to provide text-to-speech functionality with speak/stop controls and speaking state tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm earthy color palette (terracotta, sand, amber) for light and dark modes, plus a voice-pulse animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that sets up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup helpers for managing parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom OKLCH color variables, sidebar colors, border radius tokens, animations (accordion), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing an organizer app with voice features and messenger functionality, operating in public/shared mode without authentication, listing existing features and image requirements.
